fact: The Banco de Cabo Verde continued in 2024 its revision of the legal framework for payment services and the issuance of electronic money, with changes to the earlier revision proposal.
system: Payment services and e-money legal framework

fact: In 2024 the Banco de Cabo Verde operated the SGDL settlement system daily and followed daily the interbank clearing systems making up the SICIL, completing assessments of financial market infrastructures.
The Banco de Cabo Verde says payment institutions and e-money institutions must be authorised by it to provide payment services or issue e-money, under Decree-Laws 8/2018 and 9/2018 and Aviso 6/2019.

fact: The Banco de Cabo Verde says it manages SICIL, the interbank clearing system for cheques, credit transfers and payment cards operated by SISP, and oversees the payment system under its oversight policy.

Expresso das Ilhas, reporting the Banco de Cabo Verde's 2025 payment system report, says the central bank judged the clearing and settlement system SGDL, which processed 56.9 million payment operations in 2025, to have run safely and regularly, and it inspected the operator SISP.
The article says Aviso n.6/2019, published 18 July 2019, governs authorisation of payment institutions and e-money institutions, with capital of 2 million to 20 million escudos by activity.
